items.statement: The submitted calculation uses the explicit 50-atom PBNA system as neutral singlet and preserves the stated molecular boundary.
items.expected: PBNA; 50 atoms with 24 C, 22 H, 2 B, 2 N; charge 0; multiplicity 1; isolated molecule.

items.statement: The reported properties come from a converged stationary-point workflow with vibrational validation.
items.expected: Optimization convergence is documented and the final structure is reported as a minimum with zero imaginary frequencies, or bounded failure is honestly reported.

items.statement: PBNA frontier-orbital energies are quantitatively reproduced within method-dependent reporting uncertainty.
PBNA thermochemical quantities are reported in the SI convention.
